title: Insight into the oxidase-mimicking activity enhancement of MnO2 nanozymes by Co ion-doping for colorimetric sensor assays
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,34537-34550
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA03755G, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Thi-Hien Pham, Xuan-Dinh Ngo, Nguyen Van Tuyen, Chu Xuan Quang, Pham-Cong De, Tan Van Tran, Nguyen Pham Duy Linh, Van-Tuan Hoang, Anh-Tuan Le
Co-MnO2 nanoparticles with oxygen vacancies and Mn/Co redox couples exhibit enhanced oxidase-mimicking activity. This highlights Co ion-doping as an effective strategy for performance improvement in nanozymes for colorimetric assays.
